title: feat: rfc10008 http query method
body:
Fixes #6807 

@kalvenschraut Do point out a valid view about the "Proposed Standard" on RFC

I have look though the history of RFC10008 and it takes about 11 years (2015 - 2026 Jun) to the current state. 
It should receive good amount of reviews and good to use.

#### Checklist

- [ ] run `npm run test && npm run benchmark --if-present`
- [ ] tests and/or benchmarks are included
- [ ] documentation is changed or added
- [ ] commit message and code follows the [Developer's Certification of Origin](https://github.com/fastify/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developers-certificate-of-origin-11)
      and the [Code of conduct](https://github.com/fastify/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
